description: The multi-flavor product manifest: the contract the build, manifest merger, and release-acceptance checks enforce. Legacy top-level fields below describe the product-wide device/permission policy; the authoritative per-flavor data lives in the flavors array. Only flavors with qualified=true may be imported or launched.

flavors.client_version: 1.12.1 build 5875 (user-supplied; PE/build fast scan on first connect and full managed import)
flavors.supported_client_builds_note: Populated once exact client hashes are qualified (port plan S5). The qualified flag above, not this list, currently gates import.

bot_policy.characters_per_account_note: bot-headroom cap (player character occupies one slot); client UI cap is 10 per realm

mpq_set.note: Vanilla flat Data/ layout. patch-*.mpq optional and accepted by the MPQ magic check when present.

flavors.client_version: 2.4.3 build 8606 (user-supplied; qualification pending, port plan stage S5)
flavors.supported_client_builds_note: Empty until the genuine 2.4.3.8606 client is hash-qualified in port plan S5. Import must reject while qualified=false.

bot_policy.characters_per_account_note: bot-headroom cap (player character occupies one slot); client UI cap is 10 per realm

mpq_set.note: Derived from the genuine qualified client in port plan S5; empty until then.

flavors.client_version: 3.3.5a build 12340 (user-supplied; qualification pending, port plan stage S5)
flavors.supported_client_builds_note: Empty until the genuine 3.3.5a.12340 client is hash-qualified in port plan S5. Import must reject while qualified=false.

bot_policy.characters_per_account_note: bot-headroom cap (player character occupies one slot); client UI cap is 10 per realm

mpq_set.note: Derived from the genuine qualified client in port plan S5; empty until then.

target_device_profile.development_abi: x86_64 on the fixed emulator lanes recorded under tests/avd/

includes.android_app: Kotlin/Compose launcher, supervisor, wizard, foreground service, controller bridge
includes.native_realm: Supervised native MariaDB, realmd, mangosd, and Playerbots components; x86_64 development then arm64-v8a parity
includes.persistence: App-private MariaDB datadir/socket, migration ledger, dirty recovery, and database-consistent verified backups
includes.client_import: Build-5875 validation plus resumable managed copy and checkpointed DBC/maps/vmaps/mmaps preparation
includes.runtime_provider: x86DirectWine first; ARM Box64/Wine WoW64 after integrated x86; alternative runtimes are outside the release critical path
includes.addons: Minimal project-owned controller/status/bot UI plus curated reversible profiles

excludes_from_release_artifact.proprietary_client_files: WoW.exe, MPQs, DBCs, maps, models, textures — never bundled; user imports them
excludes_from_release_artifact.connected_code: No connected transport, Realm Kernel, replication, or membership code in the offline APK
excludes_from_release_artifact.connected_permissions: No INTERNET-dependent authority, P2P, or relay permissions
excludes_from_release_artifact.hidden_online_switch: No runtime flag re-enables connected behavior

android_permissions.foreground_service_type: specialUse (long-running local realm server; dataSync is capped at 6h on Android 15 and unsuitable for multi-hour play)
android_permissions.storage: Scoped storage / SAF for client import and exports only
android_permissions.network_policy: INTERNET permits app-local TCP sockets and optional explicitly configured update checks; offline play binds realm endpoints to 127.0.0.1 and has no external authority dependency.

legacy_vanilla_fields.rule: Device/permission policy is shared across flavors. Per-flavor qualification is governed solely by the flavors array; connected-realm functionality remains excluded from every flavor.
